prompts.task: Audit ./service with $otel-audit, focusing on per-tool content coverage at the actual app.py run_tool boundary. Produce the normal validated canonical .observe/otel-audit.json and .observe/otel.html, plus .observe/tool-message-field-gaps.json and .md. Do not modify application, dependency, configuration or test files, execute the application/SDK/model/provider/cloud, or rewrite the supplied fixture. Read eval/inputs/genai-tool-message-mapping.json and the dated official SDK/semconv source snapshots. Treat its spans/actual_call records as separate synthetic source cases, not runtime proof for app.py. Inspect every case from actual tool-scoped fields, actual arguments/result availability and supplied call identity; a parent span's messages or a claimed SDK creator do not supply fields on the tool span. Record case_id, tool_span_id, observed field/value/schema/correlation evidence, coverage gaps or reasoned applicability, and proof limits for every case. Do not classify by case name alone. Keep actual produced null or other falsy success values distinct from absent result on failure; use only supported schemas/equivalents and never manufacture a success result or object wrapper to satisfy an incompatible schema. For live source gaps, apply the loaded skill's per-tool closure contract at the real supported app.py tool boundaries. Keep required_fix, each named tool's expected_telemetry, acceptance and verification scenario consistent; preserve canonical source scope rather than promoting unrelated synthetic tools into app.py. Bound redacted meaningful content at named pre-SDK/export hooks, preserve official Opt-In provenance versus vendor/profile acceptance, and keep parent/model messages separate from per-tool evidence. Preserve an existing source-backed producer and choose the skill's fresh-agent default for this live app when no GenAI producer exists; evaluation-only SDK use is separate. Use the supplied dated official sources for concrete creator/example/revision/version provenance where relevant; do not invent installation, live latest lookup or emitted/runtime/cloud proof. For each proposed fresh SDK creator, record a concrete official example pathname present in the supplied source snapshot, its resolved revision, capture date and package/runtime compatibility; distinguish an example's demonstrated calls from methods established only by API signatures or implementation source (for example flush/terminate). Apply the loaded physical SDK hook contract in the canonical executable handoff: name a source-backed pre-SDK sanitized metadata carrier and the public SpanExporter.export/ReadableSpan adapter on the same SDK-created span context, check the proposed SDK version and selected export sink, and keep native SDK originals safe before every sink. A generic supported-hook promise or signatures alone do not close this prerequisite. If the supplied source evidence cannot establish the concrete hook or sink compatibility, mark the exact prerequisite Partial and state the required proof without claiming executable closure. Review eval/inputs/genai-tool-enrichment-evidence.json as separately supplied producer/source compatibility evidence: inspect its concrete safe-carrier, adapter, version and selected-sink records and negative contracts. Keep its synthetic/source-check scope and proof limits distinct from live app.py execution or installed runtime support; do not claim dated main0.5 compatibility from a checked0.4 path or treat an unused adapter, raw native originals, or generic-hook declaration as closure. Where an owning native tool span contains a schema-incompatible result or spurious success output after a no-result error, bind the precise normalization requirement in the canonical handoff: validated same-span attributes plus an explicit removal set limited to that tool's relevant content keys, removing incompatible/fabricated native fields before merging supported equivalents. Preserve unrelated attributes, original context/parent/status and dropped counts. Do not treat a merge-only addition as removing the invalid native field or use export-time cleanup as permission to capture raw native secrets. If the chosen version cannot safely represent the actual result or support this selected-sink path, keep the exact prerequisite Partial.

judge_inputs: Inspect the loaded per-tool coverage contract, actual app.py run_tool source, all supplied genai-tool-message-mapping.json cases and the generated canonical audit/HTML plus tool-message-field-gaps.json/.md. Compare actual child-tool attributes, source call values, result presence, typed-parts/value validity and caller identity rather than trusting case labels, parent content or SDK method names.

Check each live named tool in canonical required_fix, expected_telemetry and acceptance/scenarios. Missing or malformed/mismatched vendor input/output mapping must remain executable coverage gaps even when tool.call.arguments/result already exist. Explicitly source-supported OpenInference equivalents may satisfy the same mapping; copied parent messages do not. Supplemental synthetic cases must not create phantom app operations.

Inspect source and proof limits. This task is a read-only audit, not instrumentation or a runtime test. SDK example/source snapshots provide dated source evidence only. Preserve actual errors and produced-result distinctions; meaningful redacted typed-parts/schema correspondence and supported equivalent values are required, not metadata-only assertions or invented successful output.

Independently inspect physical SDK hook and provenance closure in the canonical handoff: concrete official example path plus revision/date/package/runtime compatibility, precise distinction between example-demonstrated and signature/source-only APIs, pre-SDK safe metadata carrier and named public SpanExporter.export/ReadableSpan same-context adapter with selected-sink/version checks and native-original safety. Accept a precise Partial prerequisite when unsupported; do not turn a generic enrichment promise into verified API support. Compare the supplied genai-tool-enrichment-evidence.json positive and negative source contracts rather than inferring actual app emission from the fixture or mixing checked0.4 support with proposed/unproven0.5 support. Inspect selective-removal contracts for native schema-invalid result and no-result error output: an explicit validated removal set must be limited to owning tool-content keys and applied before same-context merge, preserving unrelated attrs/status/IDs/drop counts. A merge-only OI addition leaves incompatible native fields unresolved, while export scrubbing cannot justify raw native capture.
rubric: Independently assesses every supplied case from its actual_call and child tool span(s): arguments/result-only and parent-messages-only remain incomplete; correct typed-parts tool messages or explicitly supported native OpenInference mappings match real arguments/results and tool-call identity; malformed schema, mismatched mapped values or call IDs, and missing successful output mapping remain gaps. Distinguishes produced successful null from absent result on failure without fabricating object-shaped data or unsupported schema support. Names exact missing/mismatched fields with evidence and does not use case labels or SDK names as coverage.

Promotes the actual live app.py run_tool coverage gap into the canonical selected finding: for each source-backed named tool, required_fix, its own expected_telemetry attributes, acceptance and scenario bind redacted actual arguments to vendor tool input messages alongside tool.call.arguments and actual produced results to vendor tool output messages alongside tool.call.result, or name supported OpenInference equivalents and their semantic/schema correspondence. Global parent/agent/model message fields or supplemental sidecar-only advice do not close per-tool coverage. No phantom synthetic tool names, workflow or retrieval operations enter live app scope.

Preserves source-backed existing producer/provider/export paths and fills only missing fields; uses Splunk AO span creation for the actual fresh live agent while treating evaluation-only SDK usage separately. Names source-backed or proposed supported capture hooks and actual creators/example/version provenance, requires bounded useful redaction before native capture and every sink, and keeps official OTel Opt-In levels distinct from required vendor/profile acceptance. No duplicate span producers, SDK source edits, fabricated values or metadata-only closure. The fresh-creator receipt names a concrete official example path actually present in the supplied snapshot together with revision, capture date and proposed package/runtime compatibility; signature-only calls such as flush/terminate are not falsely attributed to an example. The canonical executable handoff identifies a concrete source-backed pre-SDK sanitized metadata carrier plus a named public SpanExporter.export/ReadableSpan adapter retaining the same SDK span context, version-checks the selected export sink, and makes native originals safe before every sink, or marks the precise unsupported prerequisite Partial with required proof. Generic supported-hook/enrichment promises and signature presence alone do not establish executable closure. For native schema-invalid result or spurious no-result success output, the owning canonical prerequisite specifies validated fields plus an explicit selective removal set restricted to that tool's relevant content keys before same-context merge; preserves unrelated attributes, status, original IDs/parent and dropped counts; never invents an object result or permits raw native capture. A merge-only alternative remains incomplete, and an unrepresentable value or unsupported selected-sink version remains precisely Partial.

Handles lifecycle/source boundaries honestly: failed tools with no produced result have reasoned output applicability and error evidence, never fabricated success; successful produced values require truthful output mapping. Synthetic captured spans and schema checks remain separate from live source findings and unrun application/SDK/export/cloud proof. The canonical audit and per-tool receipt cover all requested cases without mutating business behavior/config/tests or claiming emissions, latest networking, SDK installation or resource creation not performed.
